author: Ari Koslow
title: Eury Perez to start Sunday
desc: Eury Perez will start for the Marlins on Sunday against the Brewers.
impact: Perez will close out the first series out of the All-Star break for Miami. He has allowed two runs or less in four straight starts since returning from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Meyer to start Saturday
desc: Max Meyer will start on Saturday against the Brewers.
impact: Meyer posted a stifling 2.58 ERA during the first half of the season. He'll look to continue that with one of the top teams in all of baseball.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sandy Alcantara to start Friday
desc: Sandy Alcantara will start on Friday against the Brewers.
impact: Alcantara will take the mound first for the Marlins out of the All-Star break. He finished the first half strong after going through some ups and downs.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sonny Gray to start Sunday for Boston
desc: Sonny Gray will start on Sunday against the Rays.
impact: Gray was one of the top starting pitchers in baseball the first half of the season. He was originally a top contender to be traded, but Boston has played itself into the Wild Card race in the American League.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Patrick Sandoval to start Saturday
desc: Patrick Sandoval will start on Saturday against the Rays.
impact: Sandoval allowed one run over 4 1/3 innings against the White Sox in his season debut. He threw 65 pitches which he'll continue to build-up.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Bennett to start Game 1 of doubleheader Friday
desc: Jake Bennett will start Game 1 of Friday's doubleheader against the Rays.
impact: Bennett will take the mound first out of the All-Star break for Boston. He carried a terrific 2.64 ERA into the break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Robert Gasser to start Sunday
desc: Robert Gasser will start for the Brewers on Sunday against the Marlins.
impact: Gasser will close out the first series after the All-Star break for Milwaukee. He allowed seven runs to the Pirates in his final start before the break, but before that he allowed three runs or less in four straight starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shane Drohan to start Saturday for Brewers
desc: Shane Drohan will start on Saturday against the Marlins.
impact: Drohan has posted a 3.00 ERA across three starts in July prior to the All-Star break. He'll look to carry that momentum into the rest of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Henderson to start Friday
desc: Logan Henderson will start on Friday against the Marlins.
impact: Henderson will take the mound first out of the All-Star break for the Brewers. He posted a 3.18 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ronald Acuna Jr. (hamstring) playing in rehab game Thursday
desc: Ronald Acuna Jr. is playing in his third rehab game on Thursday.
impact: Acuna will likely be activated from the injured list later in July early in the second half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Lopez to enter Athletics rotation, start Sunday
desc: Jacob Lopez will start for the Athletics on Sunday against the Nationals.
impact: Lopez enters the rotation with Aaron Civale designated for assignment. He'll close out the first series out of the All-Star break for the Athletics.

author: Ari Koslow
title: J.T. Ginn to start Saturday
desc: J.T. Ginn will start on Saturday against the Nationals.
impact: Ginn will be looking to bounce back after allowing eight runs to the White Sox in his final start before the All-Star break. He still posted a strong 3.67 ERA overall.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gage Jump to start Friday for Athletics
desc: Gage Jump will start for the Athletics on Friday against the Nationals.
impact: Jump will take the mound for the first game out of the All-Star break. He delivered a stifling 2.31 ERA during the month of June.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Feltner to start Sunday
desc: Ryan Feltner will start for the Rockies on Sunday against the Reds.
impact: Feltner will close out the first series after the All-Star break for Colorado. He posted a 4.55 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tomoyuki Sugano expected to start Saturday
desc: Tomoyuki Sugano is expected to start on Saturday against the Reds.
impact: Sugano has been on the injured list since July 4 with back spasms. He is expected to return from the IL ahead of Saturday.
